gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -2.2 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -2.2 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: EFI and Agfa’s DPS Business to Combine  and Form a Global, Full-Service Industrial Inkjet Company
top.summary: Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) and Agfa-Gevaert announced a definitive agreement to combine Agfa's Digital Printing Solutions business with EFI. Siris will hold 60% and Agfa will hold 40% of the jointly held company. The combined entity is expected to generate approximately €540 million ($625 million) in 2026 revenue, serving customers across more than 100 countries with complementary geographic strengths and anticipated significant synergies.

top.title: Agfa-Gevaert NV verlengt doorlopende kredietfaciliteit
top.summary: Agfa-Gevaert NV has extended its revolving credit facility of €180 million until August 1, 2030, two years beyond the previous expiration date of August 1, 2028. The facility will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, with financial covenants including a maximum leverage ratio of 3.0 and minimum interest coverage ratio of 4.0. The facility is now secured by a pledge on Agfa HealthCare shares and is organized by a consortium of four Belgian banks.

top.title: Siris neemt het belang van 19,1% van Active Ownership in Agfa-Gevaert NV over
top.summary: Siris Capital Group has agreed to acquire a 19.1% stake in Agfa-Gevaert NV from Active Ownership as part of a strategic investment. The transaction is contingent on the completion of the previously announced merger between Agfa's Digital Printing Solutions business and Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI), a Siris portfolio company. Siris plans to serve as a constructive shareholder supporting Agfa's growth and ongoing transformation.

top.title: EFI en de DPS-activiteiten van Agfa worden samengevoegd in een wereldwijd opererende, full-service onderneming op het gebied van industriële inkjettechnologie
top.summary: Electronics for Imaging (EFI) and Agfa-Gevaert's Digital Printing Solutions (DPS) division are merging to create a global full-service industrial inkjet technology company. Siris will hold 60% ownership while Agfa retains 40% in the joint venture. The combined entity is expected to generate approximately €540 million in 2026 pro forma revenue, serving thousands of customers across 100+ countries with complementary geographic strengths and anticipated significant synergies.

top.title: argenx Presents New Data at AANEM and MGFA Scientific Session Showcasing Earlier and Sustained Treatment in MG and CIDP with VYVGART and Progress Across its Neuromuscular Pipeline
top.summary: argenx presented new clinical data at the AANEM and MGFA scientific sessions demonstrating deepening improvements in ocular myasthenia gravis (MG) with VYVGART, sustained one-year efficacy in anti-AChR antibody-negative MG patients, and benefits of earlier treatment initiation. Real-world evidence from over 1,100 U.S. MG patients showed greater clinical gains when treatment started within one year of diagnosis. Long-term CIDP data reinforced consistent safety and efficacy, with a Phase 4 study supporting direct transition from IVIg. Pipeline candidates empasiprubart and adimanebart showed promising Phase 2 results in multifocal motor neuropathy and congenital myasthenic syndrome respectively.

top.title: Arvinas Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of ARV-6723, the Company’s First Immuno-Oncology Candidate
top.summary: Arvinas announced the first patient dosing in a Phase 1/2 clinical trial of ARV-6723, an oral PROTAC designed to degrade HPK1 for advanced solid tumors. The drug is Arvinas' first immuno-oncology candidate and the first HPK1 PROTAC degrader to enter clinical trials in the US. Preclinical data showed potent HPK1 degradation, enhanced immune activity, and antitumor effects as monotherapy and in combination with anti-PD-1 therapy, including activity in anti-PD-1-resistant models.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Alibaba Group Holding Limited (BABA) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Alibaba Group Holding Limited on behalf of investors who purchased securities between June 26, 2025 and June 24, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Alibaba failed to disclose its affiliation with China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT), which classified it as a Chinese military company under the National Defense Authorization Act, and concealed ongoing unauthorized access to third-party AI models. The stock declined following these disclosures in June 2026. The deadline to file a lead plaintiff motion is October 5, 2026.

top.title: 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge Grand Finals and Awards Ceremony Held in Hangzhou
top.summary: The Global Open-source AI Challenge concluded its Grand Finals in Hangzhou on September 22-23, 2026, attracting over 14,000 developers from 91 countries with 2,999 submissions. ExpLoop Lab won the GOAI Grand Prize (1 million RMB) for its MirrorPeptidizer peptide design algorithm. The competition featured four tracks covering Agent infrastructure, industry applications, AI research, and embodied intelligence, with winners announced across six competition units. The event included industry matchmaking sessions connecting projects with investment and corporate partners.

top.title: BABA 9-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Alibaba Group Holding Limited Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 5, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline

The lawsuit covers the period from June 26, 2025 to June 24, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 5, 2026. Stock prices fell following regulatory designations and reports of fraudulent AI model access.

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Australia's EV market is projected to grow from US$660 million in 2025 to US$952.3 million by 2030, driven by policy support, improved model availability, and fleet electrification. Chinese brands like BYD and MG are intensifying price competition, while charging infrastructure expands beyond highways to regional and urban areas. Tesla faces increasing competition from established automakers and new entrants across affordable and premium segments.

top.title: Solera s’engage, à la suite d’une réunion de haut niveau avec le CATARC, à devenir un partenaire mondial de l’expansion internationale du secteur chinois des véhicules à énergies nouvelles
top.summary: Solera Holdings has committed to becoming a global partner for China's new energy vehicle (NEV) sector expansion following a high-level meeting with CATARC, China's national automotive research and certification authority. Solera will provide comprehensive support across the vehicle lifecycle including after-sales services, claims management, data standardization, regulatory compliance, and circular economy initiatives to assist Chinese NEV manufacturers in international markets.

top.title: Solera bekräftigt nach hochrangigem Treffen mit CATARC sein Engagement als globaler Partner bei der internationalen Expansion der chinesischen Industrie für Fahrzeuge mit alternativen Antrieben
top.summary: Solera Holdings held a high-level meeting with China's CATARC and CITS to explore collaboration opportunities supporting China's new energy vehicle (NEV) industry expansion globally. Solera highlighted its infrastructure specifically designed for electric and alternative fuel vehicles, offering comprehensive lifecycle management services including battery risk analysis, repair data, technical documentation, and training. The partnership aims to accelerate Chinese NEV manufacturers' international market entry by leveraging Solera's global operational capabilities and experience in developing international standards.

top.title: Solera asume el compromiso de convertirse en socio global para apoyar la expansión internacional del sector chino de vehículos de nueva energía, tras la reunión de alto nivel con CATARC
top.summary: Solera Holdings has announced a strategic partnership commitment with China Automotive Technology and Research Center (CATARC) to support Chinese new energy vehicle (NEV) manufacturers' global expansion. The meeting, attended by senior executives from both organizations and CITS representatives, focused on exploring cooperation in technology, post-sale ecosystems, claims management, training, and circular economy initiatives. Solera highlighted its globally-developed infrastructure specifically designed for electric and new energy vehicles, positioning itself as a key enabler for Chinese automakers entering international markets.

top.summary: Quantum-Si announced interim development results for its next-generation Proteus platform, showing significant performance improvements over its commercially available Platinum Pro instrument. top.title: CAPR 2-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Capricor Therapeutics, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before September 28, 2026 Deadline
top.summary: Capricor Therapeutics faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging materially misleading statements regarding clinical trial data for its lead drug candidate deramiocel. The company's stock crashed 64% after FDA briefing documents revealed undisclosed modifications to the statistical analysis plan for the HOPE-3 study, which failed to meet pre-specified primary and secondary efficacy endpoints. Investors with losses between December 17, 2025, and July 26, 2026, have until September 28, 2026, to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.title: CAPR INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Capricor Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on September 28, 2026
top.summary: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP is investigating securities fraud claims against Capricor Therapeutics for allegedly making misleading statements about its Deramiocel drug's regulatory prospects. The company allegedly failed to disclose changes to its statistical analysis plan and lack of FDA agreement before resubmitting the Biologics License Application. Capricor's stock plummeted 64% on July 27, 2026, after the FDA released unfavorable briefing documents, and fell an additional 36% on July 30, 2026, following an AdCom panel's 9-3 vote against the drug's efficacy. Investors who purchased securities between December 17, 2025 and July 26, 2026 may be eligible to participate in the class action lawsuit, with a September 28, 2026 deadline to seek lead plaintiff status.

top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Avis Budget Group, Inc. and Pentwater Capital Management LP, alleging that defendants orchestrated a market manipulation scheme. Investors who purchased Avis securities during this period may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is September 29, 2026.

top.title: Digital Realty 调研发现：超半数亚太企业计划将 AI 投资增加 25% 以上
top.summary: Digital Realty's 2026 Global Data Insights Survey reveals that 59% of Asia Pacific enterprises plan to increase AI investment by over 25% in 2026. However, the region shows significant variations in converting investments to business value, with different markets prioritizing different needs: Australia leads in ROI realization (33%), Japan emphasizes compliance, Singapore focuses on infrastructure readiness, and Korea prioritizes data interconnectivity. The survey highlights that 92% of Asia Pacific respondents link data location strategy to AI plans, though only 22% have fully integrated hybrid infrastructure.

top.summary: Digital Realty's 2026 Global Data Insights Survey reveals that 59% of Asia Pacific respondents expect their companies to increase AI investment by 25% or more in 2026, exceeding the global average of 55%. However, AI adoption maturity varies significantly by market: Australia leads in realizing AI ROI (33%), Japan prioritizes regulatory compliance, Singapore faces infrastructure gaps, and South Korea emphasizes interconnection capabilities. The survey highlights that while 92% of APAC respondents align data location strategies with AI plans, only 22% report fully integrated hybrid infrastructure, indicating ongoing challenges in connecting distributed environments across the region.

top.title: Hausse de la fraude liée aux demandes de carte de crédit : les voleurs d’identité ciblent les Canadiens de 56 à 65 ans de manière disproportionnée
top.summary: Equifax Canada reports an 8% year-over-year increase in credit card application fraud in Q2 2026, primarily driven by third-party identity theft targeting Canadians aged 56-65. While fraud in auto loans, mortgages, and telecommunications declined, overall consumer debt reached $2.68 trillion with delinquency rates rising 11.7%, indicating persistent financial pressure on Canadian households.

top.title: Credit Card Application Fraud Climbs as Identity Thieves Disproportionately Target Canadians Aged 56 to 65
top.summary: Credit card application fraud in Canada rose 8% year-over-year in Q2 2026, reaching 0.91%, driven primarily by third-party identity theft. Canadians aged 56-65 are being disproportionately targeted by fraudsters exploiting higher credit limits and infrequent credit report monitoring. The fraud surge occurs amid rising consumer debt ($2.68 trillion) and increased delinquencies, while auto, mortgage, and telecommunications fraud rates declined.

top.title: EHang’s Global Fast Track Program Expands to Vietnam, Its Second Country, Joining Hands with Hanoi to Build a Low‑Altitude Sandbox
top.summary: EHang announced the expansion of its Global Fast Track Program to Vietnam, making it the second country after Sri Lanka to join the initiative. Through a partnership with HungViet Technology and the Hanoi Department of Science and Technology, EHang will conduct regulatory sandbox testing of its EH216-S pilotless eVTOL aircraft in Hanoi starting October 2026. The collaboration aims to develop compliant validation pathways for safe operations and advance the low-altitude economy in Vietnam, with plans to expand to Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang.

It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

top.title: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages FuelCell Energy, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - FCEL
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against FuelCell Energy, Inc. (FCEL) for allegedly making false and misleading statements regarding manufacturing capacity, production rates, and profitability. The lawsuit claims defendants failed to disclose that FuelCell's manufacturing capacity was inadequate to meet production requirements under a capital equipment purchase agreement with Fit Energy, resulting in higher costs and slower delivery rates. Investors who purchased FCEL securities between June 24, 2026 and September 1, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 10, 2026.

top.title: GDDY DEADLINE ALERT: ROSEN, A GLOBALLY RESPECTED LAW FIRM, Encourages GoDaddy Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – GDDY
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm has issued multiple securities class action deadline alerts for investors. GoDaddy Inc. faces allegations of making false statements about customer growth strategy and average order size, with an October 20, 2026 lead plaintiff deadline. The firm is also handling class actions for FuelCell Energy Inc. and The Simply Good Foods Company with similar investor protection deadlines.

top.title: SMPL DEADLINE: ROSEN, NATIONAL TRIAL COUNSEL, Encourages The Simply Good Foods Company Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important October 13 Deadline in Securities Class Action – SMPL
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm announced securities class action lawsuits against multiple companies. The Simply Good Foods Company faces allegations of making false statements regarding its OWYN acquisition, including undisclosed loss of key personnel, product quality issues, margin erosion, and failure to achieve strategic goals. Similar class actions have been filed against FuelCell Energy and GoDaddy, with important lead plaintiff deadlines approaching.

top.title: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Unicycive Therapeutics, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - UNCY
top.summary: Rosen Law Firm is soliciting investors for multiple securities class action lawsuits. The primary case involves Unicycive Therapeutics, which allegedly made false statements about its manufacturing vendor's FDA compliance and the regulatory approval timeline for its drug oxylanthanum carbonate. The firm is also handling class actions for FuelCell Energy and GoDaddy, with lead plaintiff deadlines approaching in November 2026.

top.title: ROSEN, A TOP-RANKED LAW FIRM, Encourages Lincoln Educational Services Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - LINC
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (LINC) alleging that defendants made false and misleading statements about the company's admissions process and student conversion rates. The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose a significant drop in student starts relative to enrollment, and that positive statements about the business lacked a reasonable basis. Investors who purchased LINC securities between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 10, 2026.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (LINC) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: Lincoln Educational Services Corporation (LINC) is facing a class action securities fraud lawsuit for allegedly making false statements about its business between May 11 and August 9, 2026. The company failed to disclose that its admissions process was not effectively converting enrolled students to actual class attendees, resulting in only 1% student start growth despite 9% enrollment growth. The stock fell 24.93% on August 10, 2026 when the issue was revealed. Investors have until November 10, 2026 to file a lead plaintiff motion.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Palisade Bio to Present Clinical and Translational Data for PALI-2108 in Ulcerative Colitis and Crohn’s Disease at UEG Week 2026
top.summary: Palisade Bio announced that its lead program PALI-2108, an oral PDE4 inhibitor prodrug, will be featured in four presentations at UEG Week 2026 in Barcelona. The presentations will showcase Phase 1b findings in fibrostenotic Crohn's disease, early clinical activity in ulcerative colitis, favorable safety and tolerability, gut-targeted exposure, and a biomarker to predict treatment response. PALI-2108 is advancing into Phase 2 clinical development for both ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.

top.title: Arvinas Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 1/2 Clinical Trial of ARV-6723, the Company’s First Immuno-Oncology Candidate
top.summary: Arvinas announced the first patient dosing in a Phase 1/2 clinical trial of ARV-6723, an oral PROTAC designed to degrade HPK1 for advanced solid tumors. The drug is Arvinas' first immuno-oncology candidate and the first HPK1 PROTAC degrader to enter clinical trials in the US. Preclinical data showed potent HPK1 degradation, enhanced immune activity, and antitumor effects as monotherapy and in combination with anti-PD-1 therapy, including activity in anti-PD-1-resistant models.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Pentair plc Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Pentair plc alleging that company executives made materially false statements and failed to disclose significant inventory destocking in the Pool channel that adversely affected sales and operating income during the period of April 28, 2026 to July 14, 2026. Investors who purchased Pentair securities during this period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 2, 2026.

top.title: PNR 6-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Pentair plc Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 2, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
top.summary: Hagens Berman has expanded a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Pentair plc, covering the period from March 11, 2025 to July 14, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Pentair and its executives made materially false statements regarding the company's financial health and failed to disclose severe channel inventory destocking in its Pool segment. On July 14, 2026, Pentair shocked investors with a massive revenue miss ($930M vs. $1.14B forecast), slashed full-year guidance, and announced the sudden departure of its CFO after only four months. The stock plummeted 15% the following day. Investors with substantial losses have until October 2, 2026 to become lead plaintiffs.

top.title: PNR INVESTOR DEADLINE APPROACHING: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Pentair (PNR) Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on October 2, 2026
top.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Pentair plc alleging the company made false statements about its business prospects while failing to disclose significant inventory destocking in its Pool channel. The undisclosed destocking negatively impacted Pool segment sales by approximately $170 million and income by $105 million in Q2 2026, causing the stock to fall 15% on July 15, 2026. Investors who purchased Pentair securities between March 11, 2025 and July 14, 2026 have until October 2, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff status.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The company and its executives allegedly failed to disclose the fraudulent promotion scheme and insider share dumping activities. Investors have until November 9, 2026, to move to serve as lead plaintiff.

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -3.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -3.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +13.3 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +13.3 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The VARAN platform targets specifications including 500kg payload capacity, 70 km/h speed, and 4-28 hour mission time. However, no platforms have completed qualification testing, entered production, or generated revenue. The company is designing ground platforms to operate alongside aerial assets through a unified command environment.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -13.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -13.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific shows the fastest growth. Reagents & kits dominate products, while companion animals represent 61% of the market.

top.title: Zymeworks Announces Updated 2026 Financial Guidance and Final Transaction Details Following Theravance Biopharma Acquisition
top.summary: Zymeworks completed its acquisition of Theravance Biopharma, adding YUPELRI to its portfolio and providing durable cash flows. The company updated 2026 guidance to $278-292 million in total revenue and $114-128 million in Adjusted EBITDA. The acquisition is expected to deliver mid-teens IRR with immediate accretive revenue and cash flow, financed through a $350 million non-recourse note from OMERS and $217.5 million in existing cash.
